name: coding-agent-orchestrator
description: Explicit-only Coding Agent Orchestrator (CAO) with official GUI Codex subagents and deterministic .CAO state control. Activate only through a leading CAO or CAOで invocation, $coding-agent-orchestrator, explicit bundled-skill selection, or an explicit request for this workflow; generic coding and plugin inspection do not activate it.
keywords: コーディング-エージェント-オーケストレーター

interface.shortDescription: Explicit GUI coding orchestration with official subagents.
interface.longDescription: Coding Agent Orchestrator combines official GUI Codex subagent execution with deterministic .CAO workflow state and non-destructive acceptance of legacy .coding-agents state. The parent preserves task identity, epoch, scope, decisions, TODO progress, dynamic-role assignments, collected outcomes, lifecycle disposition, audit evidence, finalization, and handoff while mapping dependencies and the critical path. There is no fixed role roster. The record-only state CLI never launches workers; official collaboration tools remain the sole execution route.
defaultPrompt: CAO inspect or initialize .CAO state, map dependencies, and coordinate ready independent work through official subagents.
Use $coding-agent-orchestrator with deterministic task, decision, assignment, collection, and finalization state.
Continue the active Coding Agent Orchestrator workflow from its exact .CAO state.
